column1: CONSUMER  AFFAIRS  AUTHORITY  ACT,  No.  9  OF  2003  (AMENDED)
ACTING under the powers vested in it by Section 12 (1) of the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 9 of 2003, the Consumer
Affairs Authority directs that no manufacturer, packer, distributor, transporter, store owner or trader shall manufacture, pack,
distribute, transport, store, or sell or display for sale, expose for sale or offer for sale, wholesale or retail any items of locally
manufactured products mentioned covered by the below specifications unless it bears the SLS Product Certification Mark
issued by the Sri Lanka Standards Institution.
Further  directs,  no  importer,  packer,  distributor,  transporter,  store  owner  or  trader  shall  import,  pack,  distribute,
transport, store, or sell or display for sale, expose for sale or offer for sale, wholesale or retail any items of imported products
mentioned covered by the below specifications unless it has been inspected and approved for sale under the Import Inspection
Scheme operated by the Sri Lanka Standards Institution under the Imports (Standardization and Quality Control) Regulation
2006 made under Section 20 of the Imports and Exports (Control) Act. No. 01 of 1969, as amended by Act, No. 48 of 1985
